text:
amanda: quick smoke - brought up llama3-13b quant (4-bit PTQ asymmetric) behind the speculative prefill path. seeing ~1.3x token throughput but a small uptick in start-of-answer echoes on openqa_v1. did a few short traces, posting notes.
raj: which quant scheme? per-channel or per-tensor? asymmetric causes different zero-point shifts which can bias softmax.
amanda: per-channel asymmetric (default from our ptq tool). tried per-tensor symmetric and echo rate dropped but perf also dropped ~10%.
amanda: repro command I used:
```bash
./eval_spec.sh --model llama3-13b-4bit-ptq --quant-scheme per_channel_asym --spec_p 0.4 --fallback_thresh 0.25 --dataset openqa_v1 --out s3://redwood-eval/triage/1777660000/
```
maria: did you log the raw logits or probs? want to see KL and any calibration shift vs fp16 baseline.
amanda: saving logits. small example trace for prompt 3219:
```json
{"prompt_id":3219,"steps":[{"step":1,"spec_pred":"Yes","p_spec":0.68,"p_baseline_top1":0.45},{"step":2,"spec_pred":",","p_spec":0.60,"p_baseline_top1":0.38}],"notes":"speculative picks higher-prob filler tokens early"}
```
lee: hm that looks like speculative sampler is overconfident on certain short-span tokens. two quick options: lower spec_p or add a mild temperature on the speculative scorer.
raj: also check beam vs sample mode interaction. if final sampler is nucleus while speculative was greedy, mismatch can cause drift. set both samplers to same paramization.
amanda: good catch 1 set both to top_p=0.9, top_k=40, temp=0.9 for next run.
ci-bot: perf job finished: throughput=1.31x baseline, p95=+12ms, artifact s3://redwood-eval/triage/1777660000/logs.tar.gz
ops-sre: note that our canary pool has cudnn 9.2 vs prod 9.1; quant kernels show small fp differences. I can spin a canary with 9.1 to match.
maria: propose quick triage checklist before we consider enabling this config: 1) distributional KS on next-token probs (spec vs baseline), 2) per-prompt "start-echo" rate on top-100 problematic prompts, 3) exact-match QA on openqa_v1 holdout (n=1000), 4) per-token entropy delta.
amanda: adding also: run 3 seeds (seed in {42,99,123}), collect per-prompt repeat_count, kl_sum, em_score, p95_latency. will try quant scheme {per_channel_asym, per_tensor_sym} x spec_p {0.3,0.4}. ETA ~6h for the sweep.
lee: if we still see early echo bias after tuning, a pragmatic mitigation is cheap re-rank: keep top-8 speculative candidates, score with full model (cheap 1-pass on final sampler) and pick highest-likelihood. it's slightly more compute but may remove filler-prefers.
raj: agree. also flagging that we should compare calibration curves (predicted prob vs actual freq) for spec vs baseline. calibration shift is a good early-warning.
amanda: noted. I'll upload a CSV with columns: prompt_id, seed, quant, spec_p, kl_sum, echo_rate, em, p95. will drop notebooks in the s3 folder when done. pinging @lee @raj @maria when results land.
maria: thanks 60a. one more thing - include the exact docker image + env var dump in the artifacts so we can reproduce kernel behavior.
amanda: will do. logging `--docker-tag` and `env_dump.json`. thanks all.
